officialName: Indian Institute of Information Technology, Allahabad
about: IIIT Allahabad is a centrally funded IIIT set up in 1999 and declared an Institute of National Importance under the IIIT Act in 2014. It is a compact, fully residential campus of about 100 acres at Jhalwa on the edge of Prayagraj, laid out on a Penrose-geometry plan, with four departments: Information Technology, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Applied Sciences and Management Studies. Undergraduate intake is concentrated in three B.Tech streams (IT, ECE and IT with Business Informatics) plus five-year dual degrees, and the institute has held a NIRF Engineering rank in the 87-103 range in recent years. Its strengths lie in computing research areas such as AI, robotics, computer vision, cryptography and bioinformatics, run through dedicated centres alongside the departments.

location.connectivityNote: The campus sits at Devghat, Jhalwa (PIN 211015) on the western outskirts of Prayagraj. The institute's own reach-us page gives only the postal address and a Google Maps link, so confirm airport and railway distances with the institute or a map before travelling.

admissionRoutes.note: JEE Main rank; seats are allotted through JoSAA counselling. The institute's 2026 seat table lists 242 IT, 121 ECE and 40 IT-BI seats for the JoSAA/CSAB pool, plus 25 (IT-M.Tech), 11 (ECE-M.Tech) and 22 (IT-BI-MBA) dual-degree seats.

Eligibility Criteria - B.Tech admission on JEE Main merit through centralized allocation (CSAB/JoSAA)

admissionRoutes.note: Seats left vacant after the JoSAA rounds are filled through CSAB special rounds on JEE Main merit; the institute lists the JoSAA and CSAB seats as one pool.

admissionRoutes.note: Supernumerary seats for foreign nationals and NRIs under DASA and for Study in India (SII): the 2026 table shows 36 DASA + 29 SII seats in IT, 18 + 12 in ECE, 6 DASA in IT-BI, and 4, 2 and 3 DASA seats in the three dual degrees.
